item.title: GrapheneOS protections against data extraction from locked devices
item.description:
📝 GrapheneOS GrapheneOS has strong defenses against data extraction. GrapheneOS only supports devices implementing the latest generation secure element rate limiting. This enables using high entropy diceware passphrases not depending on the secure element rate limiting.
🔗 Read more: https://discuss.grapheneos.org/d/40700-grapheneos-protections-against-data-extraction-from-locked-devices

item.title: No Stack Overflow, No Autocomplete: What Coding Felt Like in the 80s
item.description:
📝 Realizing that the "1" that looked like a lowercase "l" had tricked you for half an hour. It's not that things are worse now. Having autocomplete, having an AI that flags the error in seconds, having an entire community one click away — that saves hours that used to get lost without learning much, just frustration.
🔗 Read more: https://comuniq.xyz/post?t=1439
